acceptance_cases.subrequirement: Exactly five public states; startup INVALID; qualified ±X creates provisional rally family; held/toss rejects; rejected same flight does not re-arm.
Confirmed first striker B1 reclassifies without losing state; known NORMAL_RALLY forbids it; forbidden order/count revokes ball target.
Outgoing RALLY B2 before opponent-end crossing retains RALLY and selects exact B1–B2 apex (state/time/uncertainty).
OPPONENT_RALLY B2 before receiving plane is forbidden; OPPONENT_SERVE needs ordered B2 then plane before B3.
A later predicted bounce after an already valid plane event does not invalidate the earlier event.
Both serve routes: new shot→provisional rally→striker B1/serve→net→receiver B2→selected ball event→**new observed racket shot boundary**; correct queue preservation/retirement.
Qualified held/non-ballistic motion, below-table states, net collision and bad clocks produce correct physical/data-quality reasons; no fabricated bounce, no apex-as-held error.
Hard new shot/INVALID/provenance change clears dependent fit/events/spin/jobs; same-shot label change preserves raw data and supersedes forecast only.
Delayed work, expired callbacks and reversal cannot republish retired **ball forecasts**. Preserve legacy precommit reversal protections by regression.
Predicted B1→confirmed B1 retains event ID, distinct occurrence/confirmation time and one contact impulse/count.
`FOLLOW_POSE`: base +0.10 X→next prediction plane +0.10; +0.58 offset, age/frame/range checked. Also test `ON_REFRESH` preservation.
Full *ball* target p/v/optional omega, reference/arrival, frame, covariance, historical status; physical Z never receives policy height offset.
150/300 Hz, jitter/dropout, exact source delta-t, causality, no cross-shot spin increment, latency/availability report.
Nominal and fallback model/config agree; distinguish warmup, horizon, uncertainty, forbidden route and revoked/stale ball events.
Valid `(0,30,0)`→missing/all-zero-sentinel/NaN/rejected→new valid; preserve complete held vector and original source time, XYZ and causal recovery at both rates.
No trusted spin→POSITION_ONLY from start through every leg/two serve contacts; no synthetic omega/postbounce Magnus.
Mutating rejected nonzero raw angular vector cannot alter result when trusted state/XYZ fixed.
acceptance_cases.review_note: V2 rejected-spin invariant is owned by native TrustedSpin and causal replay, not untouched legacy fallback.

acceptance_cases.subrequirement: Accept individual zero components; distinguish genuine identity quaternion from synthetic placeholder through authoritative source quality.
Mocap relay→v2 observation/packetizer/forecast receiver/replay preserves orientation validity, exact time and XYZ. Preserve legacy consumer behavior rather than expanding its command duties.
Measured/held spin through one/two bounces produces once-only contact-propagated spin; absent-spin remains absent.
Trusted checkpoint survives window trim/refit/transfer/reclassification and clears on hard boundary; duplicate event doesn't apply impulse twice.
q/−q, axis/frame signs, ambiguous long-gap rejection, original held-spin age and source-time delta tests.
Below-table, radius-aware finite net, real top-table footprint, edge ambiguity, target/contact earliest-event and tie ordering.
Common profile/mode in fit/nominal/fallback/V2 replay; parameter bounds, dissipative behavior, independent step/time/position convergence.
Prospective causal spin reacquisition and executable matched scoring/plotting; independent physical error/uncertainty is tracked separately as NOT_RUN.
Publish exactly the rollout's contact/target arrival time and optional spin provenance; no fixed-rate, double-age or separate physics timing approximation in **our output**.
Qualified ±X shot begins correct provisional rally; complete evidence plus no striker bounce before net confirms rally; deadband does not change owner.
Confirmed striker-side B1→same-generation serve; preserve raw timestamps/queue/spin/B1 ID, increment semantic forecast revision and propagate contact once.
Second striker-side pre-net bounce invalidates, clears active shot; a merely predicted bounce never counts as observed; supported deterministic early invalidation is conservative.
First observation after net has unknown/incomplete prehistory; physical forecast may exist, but route target must wait for reliable history/evidence.
Predicted striker B1 selects provisional serve route without public confirmation/observed count; deleting hypothesis does not reset queue.
NORMAL_RALLY context forbids striker bounce, SERVE constrains order, receiver B2 doesn't revert serve, genuinely new racket return resets ownership.
Reclassification while a solve is pending: old semantic output is fenced, preserved samples remain usable; hard reset fences all retired work.
Table/net-induced reversal is not a new racket shot; qualified same-direction contact is; label change is not a shot reset.
Every retained XYZ sample has exact original ns through both rates, trimming, queue and transport; integration uses actual delta-t.
Bounce at 10.000 s confirmed at 10.020 s keeps those two distinct timestamps plus evidence uncertainty.
Reference 20.000 s + integrated duration 0.300 s→arrival 20.300 s independent of later publish/receipt, for B1/B2/plane/end/apex.
Revision preserves event identity/history; predicted elapsed time never becomes an observation or racket contact automatically.
Expose valid source-clock mapping/uncertainty; no `strike_start` field, no timing rejection due solely to robot lead, valid sim epoch zero.
Hard boundary retires generation/forecasts, same-shot reclass preserves data and supersedes revision; no old output restores revoked ball target.
Both ON_REFRESH (frozen until refresh) and FOLLOW_POSE (fresh per forecast) are explicit and never silently substituted.
Valid moving-plane geometry is not treated as shot/ball provenance fault; real frame/calibration change still invalidates incompatible state.

Uncertain early forbidden prediction can recover with later causal observations; incomplete conditional covariance cannot justify hard invalidation; well-supported violation and confirmed forbidden event can.
Pace 150/300 Hz with occasional slower solves; monotone source-stamped publications and bounded latest-work queue, no starvation.
Ball forecasts continue and preserve physical validity despite target Y being outside robot reach range; a later flight remains qualifiable.
Duplicate/retransmitted V2 forecast packets preserve identity/hash/dedupe; producer restart and equal-counter conditions are documented without fabricating accepted events.
Ball frame/clock/reference point, p/v/optional omega, waypoint/event/plane geometry, no physical-policy Z conversion, installed v2 receiver/serializer parity.
Clean HOPE-only configure/build/install/test/replay from no private checkout or stale overlays. Report inherited lint separately from scoped functional pass; do not hide it.

One common forward/event kernel and coefficients for mean, covariance, event, fallback, V2 replay, and **forward-only** hypothetical-outgoing physics; spin after unmodelled racket impulse must not inherit incoming trusted state.
No V2 publication to production command topics, including remapping; no shadow adapter constructs racket commands.
